component: rolling disposable prefill checkpoints and the P1 state-boundary plan
modifications: Reimplemented Splash's StateBoundary purposes (checkpoint/replay/junction) as Python ROLLING/INTERIOR/JUNCTION with max-purpose dedup over one sorted plan.

Ported the rolling lifetime rules: publish each progress point immediately, retire the previous one on replacement and the last one at the committed prompt boundary, never retire a peer's recovery point, never downgrade an ordinary state, and defer retirement while a lease pins the entry.
Mapped Splash's disposable-first reclaim onto APCv2 retention ranks (prefill_rolling below interior_checkpoint) instead of a separate state cache.
Added an mlx2-specific KV-only phase that publishes a cancelled prefill's trimmable partial cache instead of periodic snapshots.
Kept the feature default-off behind the server-owned execution_policy.apc_rolling_checkpoints key.
